newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Holderbank sees no need to boost capital.
newsitem.headline: Holderbank sees no need to boost capital.

text.p: International cement and concrete maker Holderbank Financiere Glarus AG said it had no plans at the moment to raise its share capital.
Chief executive Thomas Schmidheiny said Holderbank belived that European interest rates would remain low and not change quickly.
"In this kind of environment, it is my view that we should not create new capital," Schmidheiny told a news conference on the company's 1996 results.
"The only reason (to boost capital) would be if we were planning a giant step, but I don't see that at the moment," he added without elaborating.
Schmidheiny said Holderbank was not planning any major investments at the moment but would instead "focus on fitness" with smaller steps.
